title: unified-rollouts-probing-canary-ab-autorollback-enhancements
description: Motivation: Improve safety and observability for probing staged canary/A-B rollouts and tighten automatic rollback triggers for shadow and canary traffic. This change centralizes probing logic into the unified rollouts engine, adds a probe quarantine stage to reduce false positives, exposes new telemetry for per-probing-stage metrics, and tightens metric quorum rules for auto rollback. Summary of changes: 1) New probing state machine that introduces a 'quarantine' probe substage and configurable quorum thresholds, 2) API surface to declare probe-worthy metrics and per-metric weights for composite quorum evaluation, 3) Enhanced rollback evaluator to consider multi-stage probe outcomes and a short-term anomaly window before triggering rollback, 4) Observability: new Prometheus counters and tracing spans for probe lifecycle and decision reasons, 5) E2E and unit tests for the new state transitions and threshold behavior, 6) Docs and examples for configuring probing stages in rollout manifests. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of probe state machine and evaluator - [x] Unit tests covering quorum and anomaly window - [x] Integration tests in perf-canary harness - [x] Observability dashboard JSON + metrics docs - [x] SDK example updated - [x] Linear ticket linked and changelog entry. Risk: Behavior changes auto-rollback sensitivity; default thresholds are conservative and backwards compatible. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated for the next release, staged rollout to 10% of customers, monitor new metrics for 2 weeks, then flip on by default. Related: linear/ENG-2483, ENG-2521.
